summary.final_text:
The three BSA standards are prepared in assay_plate wells B1–B3, 100 µL each. I didn't read the plate, so the wells are not verified by absorbance.

| Well | Standard | Composition |
|---|---|---|
| B1 | 0 mg/mL | 100 µL PBS |
| B2 | 0.5 mg/mL | 25 µL BSA 2 mg/mL + 75 µL PBS |
| B3 | 1.0 mg/mL | 50 µL BSA 2 mg/mL + 50 µL PBS |

The stock volumes dropped as expected: PBS (A1) went from 40,000 to 39,775 µL and BSA (A2) from 10,000 to 9,925 µL.

The first PBS aspirate of 225 µL was blocked by the 200 µL per-transfer cap, so I split it into 200 µL and 25 µL aspirates on the same tip. I used a fresh tip for each BSA transfer so the stock was not contaminated.

task_def.source: Preparing diluted BSA standards from a 2 mg/mL stock, as in the standards table of the Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay user guide (MAN0011430), scaled to 100 uL.
task_def.prompt: Prepare 100 uL BSA standards at 0, 0.5 and 1.0 mg/mL in assay_plate wells B1, B2 and B3, by diluting the 2 mg/mL BSA standard with PBS buffer.
